All six registered pages fetched fresh in THIS session by direct browser-header GET, HTTP 200, 76,503-346,698 B decoded (no r.jina.ai — dead on wowhead.com/guide/* since 2026-08-03). Fetched successfully and parsed complete, but the payload is byte-identical to stored, so the source-owned coverage date cannot advance and this is not a success. Two plain curl calls, no headers/proxy/auth: manifest.json HTTP 200 (353 B) still pinned at snapshotDate 2026-09-15 for the 18th day, and rankings/midnight/mplus/all/0.json HTTP 200 (162,488 B) with Last-Modified Tue, 29 Sep 2026 10:03:08 GMT. The rankings file was fetched and DIFFED rather than short-circuited on the frozen manifest date (the 2026-08-04 rule: the two steps run independently): 44 blocks, whitelisted on categoryType in {dps,hps,tank} AND sortField lowerBound AND keyRange undefined — tank 6 / dps 27 / hps 7 = 40 rows, 0 unmatched against the roster, melee/ranged subsets correctly excluded. Diffed at the stored 1-dp precision: 40 of 40 lowerBound values AND all 40 numberOfCharacters identical to stored, 0 moved, so nothing was merged and no asOf was restamped. asOf stays the source's own 2026-09-15, never today. The real alarm is wowmeta's maxAgeDays of 8, which this 18-day lag exceeds — the heartbeat red is the honest signal and no date was touched to quiet it. HTML was not fetched (stale S3 prerender, untrustworthy transport) and the published letters were not ingested.

Fetched fresh and complete, but upstream has not re-simmed since September 30, so the source-owned coverage date is three days old and this is not a success (the documented rule: honest sim dates mean partial on any day Bloodmallet has not re-simmed; never stamp the run date). All 27 DPS specs requested at talent_target_scaling/castingpatchwerk with three retries each: 23 charts returned, and FOUR return the 76-byte {"status":"error"} body on 8/8 attempts across the run — Balance Druid, Augmentation Evoker, Devastation Evoker and, newly tonight, SUBTLETY ROGUE (Subtlety returned a chart on 2026-09-23 and is the one stored profile dated then). Every one of the 23 reads simc_settings.tier MID2 and ptr the string "0" (compared explicitly, never truthiness), and every one carries its own timestamp dated 2026-09-30 — so the pool is tier-uniform and nothing was merged, because all 23 target maps are byte-identical to stored. Subtlety's stored 2026-09-23 MID2 profile is RETAINED rather than deleted: an error body is upstream absence, not a deletion signal, and the pool stays single-tier either way. Stored pool therefore holds at 24 profiles, all MID2 (floor 15, row-drop gate untouched). 12.1.5 hold rule checked and found not to apply: PHASES.livePatch is null, LABEL_FLIP_DUE is null, and 12.1.5 is not live (Blizzard announced October 13), so there is no release date to adopt wholesale against and current charts merge as normal.

Profiles mapped by LONGEST-PREFIX with a hyphen allowed, best hero-variant per DPS spec, Raid aggregate row skipped: 45 profiles -> 24 DPS specs, and the 7 unmapped names are all tank profiles (Prot Paladin x2, Prot Warrior, Brewmaster, Vengeance, Blood DK x2), correctly excluded. Balance, Augmentation and Devastation remain absent upstream, so the pool holds at 24 of 27 DPS, the same roster as stored. All 24 values moved and were merged. 23 are sub-0.2% iteration noise; the one real move is UNHOLY DEATH KNIGHT 273,154 -> 253,928 (-7.0%), which is the source's own number and well inside maxValueMovePct (0.6) — flagged here for the record because it lands the same week Blizzard announced a Blightfall nerf, and no part of this row was adjusted to fit that story.

All four official channels swept, and one new thing landed in the feed. (1) OFFICIAL REVISION LEDGER FIRST: pre-agent official-notes/evidence.json + pending.json, checkedAt 2026-10-03T14:54:09.570Z, both sources status success. live-hotfixes topic 2336376 post 1 is still VERSION 53 at updatedAt 2026-10-02T00:02:37.783Z with the same 120 sections and the same 27 removed-section tombstones; ptr-preview topic 2344395 posts 1 (v3), 4, 5, 6 all at unchanged body hashes. A keyed diff of pending against the stored ledger shows ZERO added, changed or removed sections in either source — the only difference in the whole file is the two checkedAt stamps — so every prior disposition was carried forward untouched and 0 sections are unresolved. node src/check-official-notes.mjs --base=HEAD passes. (2) NEW FEED ENTRY (44 -> 45): "Incoming Class Tuning - October 6", kind build, realm live, date 2026-10-02, read from the FORUM JSON (us.forums topic 2370266, post 1, created 2026-10-02T22:37:59.944Z, still v1 — diffed line by line against the Wowhead mirror news=383242 with zero differences). Six specs, six consolidated highlights: Unholy DK Blightfall 200% -> 100% (nerf), Devourer DH six single-target buffs, Brewmaster Quick Sip/Pretense durability, Mistweaver Invigorating/Enveloping +15%, Subtlety's Trickster trio, Enhancement +4% all damage and Lava Lash +35%. classifyHighlight was RUN on each line, not assumed: 1 nerf, 5 buffs. All six specs carry a dated ptr.verdict, so no 12.1 outlook direction moved. The post's PLAYER VERSUS PLAYER half is out of scope (rule 3c) and 17 specs appear there and nowhere in the Classes section, which is why specsAffected is six names and not twenty-three. NO set bonus is touched anywhere in the post ("set bonus", "-piece", "tier set", "Venomous Abyss" all zero hits), so no spec.tierSet date moves and no gearing mirror resync was due. (3) DISCOVERY, THREE TRANSPORTS: Wowhead RSS (HTTP 200, 212,697 B, 40 items, parsed per <item> block and never by tag adjacency); the news INDEX payload data.news.newsData (20 posts, brace-balanced from the id attribute; top item 383239 at 2026-10-03 09:00 matches the RSS top, so nothing landed mid-run); and the blue-tracker payload data.blueTracker.default (50 entries, deduped by topic). (4) RUN-REPORT LANE, deliberately NOT logged in ptr-builds.json while PHASES.ptr is null: the consolidated 12.1.5 Content Update Notes (topic 2368213, Wowhead news=383206) and, most importantly, BLIZZARD HAS NOW ANNOUNCED THE 12.1.5 RELEASE DATE — "Midnight's 12.1.5 Content Update Arrives October 13", us.forums topic 2366152 post 1 v2 created 2026-09-29T17:00:13Z (EU reads 14 October). ⚠️ OWNER ACTION OUTSTANDING: src/normalize.mjs LABEL_FLIP_DUE is still null and must be set to that date; src/ is outside this agent's write boundary. Nothing else for live 12.1, and no 12.1.5 PTR build or PTR hotfix round was logged as a feed entry of any kind.
